tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// gser chos// ༈ /de nas yang dag par bshad par bya ste/ 'bum phrag gsum pa las byung ba'i

bye brag sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ming gi rnam grangs/ rgyud las/ sgyu ma chen mo ral pa gyen brdzes zhes bya ba ste/ snying ga nas bam̐ dmar mo bsam de las 'od/ spros pa'i rmi lam lta bu'i lus dang longs spyod dam pa'i bde ba lhan skyes dang*/ gnyis su med par gyur pa dang*/ 'dir de'i steng du ma ning gi sa bon bam̐ dmar mo bltas te/ sa bon de yongs su gyur pa las/ dmar mo snying rje sems can gyi don la zhal gyen du phyogs shing gyen du gzigs pa/ zhabs g.yon pa lte ba'i me dang spyi bo'i hūm̐ gnyis med kyi ye shes skye bas g.yon gyi spyi gtsug g.yas kyi lte ba la mtshon pas zhabs gnyis so/ la 'khyud pa'i thod pa dang*/ me tog gi phreng bas bcings pa'i thod pa bzung ba la me tog bcings pa/ phyag mtshan can me tog gi zhags pa g.yon pa'i phyag na'o/ sa 'byar/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pa la reg pa'i g.yas pa ni/ rdo rje'i phyag can ma rgyan thams cad spangs pa'o// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba ma rig 'dzin nam mkhar 'gro ba ltar/ spro zhing kun tu dud rigs lnga'i rnal 'byor ma dkar mo sogs pa'i lus can ma/ man+da ra ba dang mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du rnams skye bar 'gyur ba'i rin po che brtsegs 'dir bsdad na sems can gyi don mi 'grub pas nam mkhar kun tu rgyu bar bya'o zhes sems bskyed pa'o/ pa'i khang par rab tu 'jug par bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o// oṃ bam̐ rdo rje phag mo'o// ham̐ yoṃ gshin rje ma'o// hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed/ hriṃ hriṃ kun tu skyod ma'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ kun tu skrag ma'o// phaṭa phaṭa gtum mo yan lag thams cad la mtshon cha'o// lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang*/ de bzhin du kha dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ spyi bo'i lte 'di mtshon cha'o// rnal 'byor

rang 'dra'i rigs lnga'i rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' gang bar spro/ lnga po 'di rnams rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen gyi ngo bo bshad do// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i go cha dgod pa rang bzhin gang zag dbang po rab la dgongs pa'o/ gyis bskyed pa'i gtor ma gzhan du na dgos so rdzas dngos mi dgos bsam pa/ sbyin par bya'o// oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra ā kar+dha ya ā kar+dha ya pra be sha ya pra be sha ya to ṣa ma sarba ḍā ki nī naṃ hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ sarba yo gi nī pra tīts+tsha maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha hi hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra yo gi n+yā ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tri sh+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ho/ rig pa 'dzin ma'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ya zhabs dang btsun pa dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /las dang po pa yin zhing spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa nas hrī da yaṃ zhes pa yan chad kyi sngags kyang man ngag tu gsungs te phyag len mi mdzad/ bzlas/ chang dang sha dang zan la sogs pa'i gtor ma bshams la lag pa g.yon sam+bha ra'i ba liṃ cho ga gzhan gyis kyang btub gsung gi sngags gcig pu'am gang gi sbrel bar bya'o/ pas reg la yi ge gsum ji ltar 'dod pa bzlas pas bdud rtsir bsams la/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams mngon sum du dmigs la sngags rnams kyis dbul/ gzhan du mi dgos so// go cha yang de dang de'i gnas su reg cing brjod pa tsam/ mai tri pa/ nam mkha'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma a/ shākya 'di man chad med pas btub ra k+ṣi ta/ ka na ka shrī/ dza ya se na/

phyis rgya gar du byon nas bla ma a nyid la phyis mai tri pa nyid kyi slob ma ka ma badz+ra bya ba bla ma khang gsar bas gsan no/ gsan/ lo ke shwa ra/ sha ba ri/ a wa dhu ti pa/ mṛ ti/ ka ma la badz+ra/ lī ma ya badz+ra/ glo lo tsā ba dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis gsan no// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ bi dh+yā dha rī ke lī shrī badz+ra wa rā hī sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin ma'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ dge tha mal pa'i lus 'di mi gtsang bas gang bar blta ba/ ba ma yin pa'i sdom pa rnams brtsam par bya ste/ blo yi dbang po mig sogs/ lnga dang*/ las kyi dbang po rkang lag gshang gci/ lnga la phyi nas sdud pa me long la kha rlangs phog pa ltar/ bltas te gong bu bsdu ba dang nang nas bshig pa ste chu la rdo ba brgyab pa ltar/ rjes su bshig pa gnyis gang gong bu bsdu ba phyag len la mdzad do/ rung gis de bzhin nyid du rab tu gzhug pa ni/ dang po/ rkang pa gnyis ni brla gnyis la'o// brla gnyis ni sked pa'i cha la'o// sked pa ni snying gar ro// lag pa dag ni dpung pa gnyis la'o// dpung pa gnyis ni snying ga la'o// snying ga ni mgrin pa la'o// mgrin pa ni mgo bo la'o// mgo bo ni sems la'o// sems ni nam mkha' la rab tu gzhug go /nam mkha' ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o// de las yongs su rdzogs pa mo ni/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma phreng ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa mo'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ste/ klu shing gi me tog gi phreng ba can thod pa bsnams pa/ ldum gyi rwa ba rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i khang par me tog gi rwa ba la gnas de nas nam mkha' la rab tu 'phags te mngon du 'gro bar bsams pa'i dus sprul pa dang bcas par bsam gsungs/

rab tu 'jug pa mo/ sa bon las kyang*/ spro zhing kun tu sdud pa'i lus su bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo na ji lta ba'i sbyor bas de bzhin du rkang pa g.yon pa'i pus mo'i 'og tu thod pa bcas pa'i lag pa g.yon pas bsdams la rkang pa g.yon sa la brdab par bya'o// de nas sems can thams cad kyi khams ji snyed pa grub pa'i dngul chu lta bur bltas la g.yon pa'i sna'i bu ga nas btung bar bya'o// yang sgyu ma lta bu'i gzugs spro ba dang bsdu ba yang de bzhin du bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo na sngags bzla bar bya'o// de'i spyod pa bshad par bya ste/ sgrub pa po rnams nus pa phra mo thob nas rus dang rigs la sogs pa'i sa nas ston pa ltar gang rung*/ la phan pa'i don du nyi ma'am zla ba gzas bzung ba la me long gi steng du kam+pa'i sin+dhu ra la gser gyi thur mas rje btsun ma bris la nye bar spyod pa lngas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ste tshogs mchod/ mngon par mchod la/ bzlas pa btang ba dang*/ de'i sin+dhu ra bzung la zangs ma'i snod du bsdus la gzhag par bya'o// laṅka li ya'i shing 'ol ma se 'dra ba sbubs can bton la rang gi gnas dgon pa sogs su bskyed par bya'o// 'di wā ra hīr bsams la zla ba drug tu so sor shing de la nyi ma re re bzhin mchod par bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu bdag la stsol/ cig gsol ba gdab/ so sor yang dag par mchod pa dang bya'o// 'dir zla ba drug tu yongs su rdzogs par byas la/ rnal 'byor ma dam tshig dang ldan pa gsum mam gcig sogs rnams la nye bar spyod pa lnga dang*/ ston mo byas la phyag byas te gnang ba nos la/ laṅka li ya'i dbus su sin+dhu ras dgang bar bya'o// zur drug pa'i rnam pa sin+dhu ras dpral ba la bris la 'phyo bar bya'o// thod pa bzung la smyon pa'i spyod pa spyad do// zla ba drug tu skud pa'i tshong dus kyi grong dang nye bar bud med mang po dag la g.yon du bskor bar brtsam par bya'o// smyon pa'i spyod pas spyad do// zla ba drug na

gong du laṅka li ya'i sgrub par zla ba drug dang*/ spyod pa zla ba drug ste bcu gnyis na mtshams med pa lnga byed pa des kyang bdag gi dpral ba'i 'khor lo de gang gi dpral bar byung na de rnal 'byor ma yin pas de la gsol ba btab pas byin gyis brlabs te/ 'grub bo// phreng ba'i sngags bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ oṃ zlos pa'i dus su oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes par bzla'o/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ pad+ma can gyi rigs kyi rang byung gi me tog dang ga bur dang tsan+dan sbyar la rgya skyegs dang bsres te bri bar bya'o// zhes bya ba ni brgyud pa'i man ngag gi rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs rgyud du ma dang sgrub thabs gnyis bag re mi 'dra ba kun phyag len sgrub thabs bzhin byed gsungs/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// kho bos rje btsun dza ya shrī se na lo tsā ba dang bcas pa las zhus so// mchan 'di rnams rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis btab pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ bid+ya dh+ya ri ki li badz+ra yo gi nī adzñā bi dhi/ bod skad du/ rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// lhan skyes bdag nyid sku can gyi// rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gus 'dud// bla ma brgyud pa las 'ongs pa// yang dag lam ster cho ga bshad// dpal phreng ba 'dzin pa'i rig pa 'dzin ma'i rim pas slob ma rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu la dben pa yid dga' ba bdud rtsi lnga la sogs par yongs su gtor ba'i gnas su bla bre la sogs pas nye bar brgyan te sin+dhu ra'i phyi ma

ma 'byor na gru bzhi pa'i maṇ+ḍal bya sa gru bzhi pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas la/ de'i dbus su chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa'o// der rdo rje 'chang gi snod ka pā la chang gis bkang ba/ kyi steng du sin+dhu ra bzang po'i phye mas yongs su gang ba'i dri ma med pa'i me long gi steng du gser gyi thur mas lag pa g.yon pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i gzugs mngon par bri bar bya'o// 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu'ang bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa'i chu klung gis yongs su gang ba'i kha lo 'dab kyis brgyan pa mgrin pa gos kyis dkris pa'i bum pa lnga'am/ yang na ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba rnams bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags nas phyogs bzhir bum pa lnga shar ram nub tu gnyis/ gzhag par bya'o// de nas sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa kha nub tu phyogs pas bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu khar bcug la/ lag pa g.yon pa go cha'i sngags kyis sbyangs pa'i sngon du yi ge gsum 'di'i cho ga gzhan dang 'dra/ brjod pas bdud rtsir byas pa'i chang gis yan lag lnga bkrus pas srid pa'i rgya mtsho las 'gro ba ma lus pa drangs par 'dod pas bzlas pa'ang bya bdag mchod kyang cung zad bya/ lha mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis drangs pa'i ye shes kyi lha mo me long la bris pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu bcug nas bza' ba dang*/ ston mo dang*/ btung ba dang*/ chang dang*/ sha dang khu ba'i khyad par rnams dang*/ dzā ti sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'bru rnams med na a ru ra gcig tsam/ dang*/ chu las skyes pa dang thang las skyes pa'i me tog mang po rnams dang*/ gtor ma lha bshos rnams dang*/ mar me'i phreng ba mang pos kyang yang dag par mchod de/ bstod na rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags brjod pas bdud rtsis tshim par byas te/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshul la mos pa'i slob ma 'jug pa'i don du bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsol ba gdab par byed/

bcom ldan ye shes mchog rdo rje// rig 'dzin rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal// snying rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du// slob ma 'jug pa 'tshal lags na// ji ltar rgyal ba kun gyis khyod// ye shes rgya mtshor byin rlabs la// de bzhin du ni ye shes rol// sems can 'di la byin rlabs rigs// zhes so// de nas rnal 'byor pa rnal 'byor slob dpon rig ma bsten pa yin na de drung du gnas par bya ste rnam par rtog pa mi 'phel ba'i rten 'brel lo gsungs/ ma'i grogs pa dang ldan pas slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bcug la maṇ+ḍal gsum byed du bcug nas gsol ba gdab bar bya'o// ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yis// 'gro ba byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs// ye shes dpal rdor rnal 'byor mar// thams cad rig pa rang gis byin// de bzhin bdag la mgon po kye// da lta nyid du sbyin par rigs// zhes lan gsum bklag par bya'o// de nas phyogs bzhir dngos su ma grub na bzhi ldan du phul ba phyogs bzhir byas par bsam/ maṇ+ḍal byed du bcug nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma la yang slob mas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ lha mo'i lus ngag yid kyis su// ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal// ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis// thams cad ye shes byin rlabs pas// de bzhin bdag rgyud dag pa la// ye shes rgyun gyis mdzad du gsol// zhes bya'o// de nas slob ma la bum pa'i chus mngon par gtor te lha mo'i gzugs su rnam par bsgoms nas go cha'i sngags kyis yongs su bsrung ste sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas mig la sogs pa yang byin brlabs byas la yang dag par mchod de/ lcags kyu sbyin zhing bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub kyi char nye bar 'dug ste/ gong gi bskyed rim bzhin bsgom du bcug la/ slob mas lha mo'i gzugs su bsgoms nas/

rnal 'byor ma'i lag pa g.yon pas mgor rtsa ba'i sngags byin gyis brlabs so// bla mas kyang ye shes kyi chus yongs su gtor ba dang lus bde ba chen pos yongs su gang ba dang*/ rtsa byin rlabs dmigs pa spos kyis yang yang bya'o/ ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du song bas/ dril bu dkrol bas bla ma'i man ngag gi ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs par bya'o// de ltar byas pas mtshams med pa byed pa yang ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur na slar yang bsod nams dang ldan pa lta ci smos/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsug pas gnas te/ ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje lag pa g.yas par byin nas/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa yang lag pa g.yon par byin te/ rkang pa g.yon pa sa la brdabs pas 'gro ba thams cad la bde ba chen po babs pas bdud rtsir gyur te/ dngul chu lta bu thod pa'i nang du rab tu zhugs par bsgoms nas thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma sgrub thabs bla ma mngon rtogs rnams dang mkha' spyod sgrub thabs rnams tshar gcig bshad do/

brgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i man ngag kyang brjod par bya'o/ gong gi bskyed rim ltar dzo gi ni bsgom du gzhug yang gong bu bsdu ba'i rjes su gzhig pa gcig rung gi mi dmigs par bya yang de la sku'i rnam par lta ba dang*/ tsakra zur drug sngags tshan lte bar 'khor ba dang gsang gnas su 'khor ba dang g.yung drung 'khyil pa gsang gnas su 'khor ba dang g.yung drung 'khyil pa mdzod spu'i thad kar 'khor ba la sogs pa'i dmigs pa de dag rim pa bzhin du spos kyin byas pas 'bab par 'gyur ro// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sin+dhu rar son par bya'o// de las spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i gzugs la yang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myangs pas mnyes par bya ste/ gtor ma'i mchod pas kyang mnyes par bya'o// gza' ba dang ston mo dang nya dang sha la sogs pas kyang yongs su gang ba'i gtor ma'i snod la yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas sam spyi gtor gzhi bdag sogs cho ga gzhung bzhin/ bdud rtsir gyur pa la sngags 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka ma hā badz+ra a kar+dha ya a kar+dha ya pra we sha ya pra we sha ya/ ro ṣa ya ro ṣa ya/ sarba ḍā ki nī naṃ pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ sarba yo gi nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha hi hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī n+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tri sh+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā zhes bya bas so// de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba byas nas bzod par gsol te/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis mnyes par byas nas/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub blangs te badz+ra muḥ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gshegs su gsol ba ni/

ye shes kyi lha mo bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o// de nas byin rlabs kyi cho ga gzhan rnams tshar ba dang*/ ji ltar nus pa po'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs de nas sin+dhu ra blangs la slob dpon dang slob ma'i dpral bar byin gyis rlabs/ pas dga' ba chen po bya'o// gnang sbyin cho ga byas pa las// bsod nams nye bar bsags pa gang*// de yis skye bo ma lus rnams// lha mo'i ye shes la gzhol shog /bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gi rim pa mkhas pa chen po rgyal ba'i sde li la badz+ra ming gzhan gyis khang pa gsar pa zhes brjod pas bris pa'o/ dpal sa skya'i gnas su phreng ba rig pa 'dzin ma'i rim pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang btsun pa dar ma yon spu lo'am tan klo mo'o/ dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gsol ba btab ste/ gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī/ 'gro la rab chags dmar ba'i mdangs ldan zhal gcig spyan gsum gyen du gzigs// g.yas g.yon phyag zhabs rtsen pa'i gar gyis mi rtog bde chen zung 'jug tshul// mkha' 'gro dpag med 'phro 'du'i lus can srid gsum bde bas tshim mdzad ma// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso la btud de de yi bsnyen sgrub cho ga bshad// dbang thob dam tshig rnam dag cing*// rjes gnang cho gas rgyud dag pa// lung dang man ngag ldan pa yi// rnal 'byor can gyis don gnyis sgrubs// de la gsum ste/ sngon du bsnyen pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ rang don dngos grub bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su mchod pa dang gtor ma ci 'grub pa bshams/ bde ba'i stan la skyil krung gis 'khod de dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/

rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dran par byas la/ thod par chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba dngos su bshams pa'am med na yid kyis bsam/ lag pa g.yon pa mtheb srin rtse sprad pas mdun nas bzung nas g.yon skor du 'bru gsum brjod cing chos 'byung bris la/ dbus su bam̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsir byin brlab/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon pa'i mthil dang mthe'u chung nas brtsams te sor mo lnga'i rtsa bar go cha'i lha mo drug gi sngags brjod cing thig le dkar po'i gnas de dag tu yig 'bru rnams gsal btab nas/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes la/ g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te lce la bzhag cing gnas gsum du thig le bya'o// de nas mig la sogs pa'i blo'i dbang po lnga dang*/ rkang lag la sogs pa las kyi dbang po lnga dang*/ phyi'i yul rnams gdod ma nas dag pa dang zhes pa sgrub btus na bzhugs/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje'i blos de bzhin nyid du rab tu gzhug cing*/ de yang gong bu bsdu ba dang rjes su gzhig pa gnyis las/ phyag len snga ma ltar mdzad pas/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi lus dang khams gsum thams cad dga' bas khams gsum thams cad 'od du zhu/ me long la has btab pa ltar rim gyis bsdus te rang gi lus la thim/ lus kyi rkang pa gnyis brla la/ de lto ba la/ de rked pa la/ de snying ga la/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la/ de snying ga la/ de mgrin pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de sems la/ de nam mkha' la/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar bsams la/ de'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin mar gyur pa ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mdangs can zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pas steng du phyogs pa/

dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du bteg nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/ man+dā ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng ba g.yon na 'dzin cing rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mor mos pa bya/ de bzhin du snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mtshogs mar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi kar mos pa bya'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du bskor zhing mig gyen du bltas la phaiṃ gyi sgra drag tu brjod/ yid kyis snying ga'i bam̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dgug gzhug bya'o// de nas dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'am/ yang na dbu rgyan rang chas su bsam mo// bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de'i lte bar 'khor lo zur drug pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi zur bzhi la dga' ba 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba g.yon du myur du 'khor bar dmigs shing*/ de dang dus mnyam du smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor bar bsams la/ yid bzung zhing rlung kha sbyor bsgoms pas drod dang mi rtog pa skye bar 'gyur ro// gsang gnas su 'khor lo 'khor ba la dmigs pas bde drod 'bar bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir spyod yul gyi gnas su 'jug par 'dod pas mkha' 'gro spro bsdu dang bcas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing*/

ma na bhaṃ ga dang*/ dpal gyi ri'i rtse mor rim gyis phyin te/ man+dā ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du rnams skyes pa'i ldum gyi rwa ba rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i khang par zhugs par bsams la/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i mthil ri la brdabs pas brtan g.yo thams cad bskyod cing sems can gyi rgyud bde bas gang zhing 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rnams rlung 'jug pa dang bstun nas g.yon gyi thod par bsdus shing sna bug g.yon nas btung bas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar bsam zhing rlung gzung*/ phyir gtong dus sems can thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam pas phyogs bcur spro zhing slar yang bsdu ba sngar bzhin bya'o// de ltar ri gnyis kyi rtse mor spos shing bsgoms la/ des skyo na sngar gyi gnas su 'dug par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o// de'i tshul ni bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma g.yon du bskor ba'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum bya'o gsungs na'ang 'bum phrag gsum mam bzhi bzla ste/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la// bzlas bsgom sum 'bum bya bar bshad// ces dang*/ rtsod dus bzhi 'gyur du ni bzlas zhes 'byung bas so// thun mtshams srod thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma lnga'am gcig bshams la mkha' 'gro lnga la 'bul te/ byin rlabs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' 'gro lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i zhal nas byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs par bsams te phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra we sha ya pra we sha ya/

to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba ḍā ki nī nāṃ hrī da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ sarba yo gi nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha hi hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra yo gi n+yāḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hoḥ zhes pa gsum la sogs pa dbul/ gal te gtor ma lnga yod cing so sor dbul na hūm̐ phaṭa yan chad kun la sbyar zhing mkha' 'gro lnga so so'i sngags la oṃ sarba yo gi nī man chad sbyar ba gsum la sogs pas so sor dbul/ mchod yon la sogs pa dang bdud rtsis mchod la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes la sogs pa'am/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang zhing dge ba bsngo/ 'di ni las dang po pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sems cung zad brtan nas gtor ma yid kyis bsams te phul kyang rung gsung ngo*// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur bsam zhing*/ dpa' mo'i go cha dang tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba byas la/ bdag dang snang ba 'di thams cad lha/ brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam rtog ye shes su shes pa'i ngang nas chos dang mthun pa'i spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// kha zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe kha zas la g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam/

bdag rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lto ba nas me 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod na snying gar rje btsun ma la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing bla ma dbu'i cha la bzhugs par bsam/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs bsams la de dag mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod do// nyal ba'i tshe gong bu bsdu ba'am/ rjes su gzhig pa gang rung gis stong par bsams la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis lha mo'i skur ldangs la snod bcud thams cad sgyu mar spro/ khrus byed na dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag par bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bkru'o// de ltar sgom bzlas la goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnyis pa rang gi don du dngos grub bsgrub pa ni/ nyi ma gzas bzung dus sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa bya zhing*/ de nas laṅka li ya'i sgrub pa zla ba drug byas nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad na/ rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam pa can dang 'phrad nas mkha' spyod la sogs pa myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhib tu gzhan du shes par bya'o// de ltar bsnyen sgrub sngon du song nas don gsum pa gzhan don slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga ni/ nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu la dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang phyag dar dang skyang nul byas par bla bre dang rgyan dgram/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rten bshams/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi ba byung lnga dang dri bzang bdud rtsi dang bcas pas byugs/ der rdul tshon dmar pos chos 'byung gru gsum bris pa'i dbus su re khā dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du bde skyong 'chi med dang sbyar ba'i myos byed kyis bkang ba ye shes kyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs par bzhag 'khar ba'i maṇ+ḍal dri ma med pa la chang gis gtor te phyis pa'i steng du sin+dhu ra dar tshags kyis btsags la snyoms par dgram/ der lag pa g.yon gser gyi thur ma dang bcas pas chos 'byung gi dbus su lha mo'i sku me ri'i bar yongs su rdzogs pa ri'i gzugs gnyis dang bcas pa bris pa sngar gyi thod pa'i steng du gzhag go

/de'i steng du dar dmar po'i gur gyis g.yogs shing khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma brgyad bshams/ bum pa lnga'am ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba lnga gzhag gsungs/ yang bum pa gcig gtsang bar byas la mgul chings dang kha rgyan dang bcud rnams dang bcas pa bshams pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang pos gang ba rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa gzhag thod pa'am med na dung chos sam ting por bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i chus yongs su gang ba bzhi phyogs bzhir gzhag bdag gi mdun du nang mchod dang rdo rje dril bu gzhag cing*/ gzhan yang gdong g.yogs dang me tog phreng ba dang sha chen la sogs pa rnams bsham mo// de nas phyi ma red kyi dus su rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa gral la rim pas 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs la rje btsun ma'i mngon rtogs rim pa gnyis bsgom/ bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de nas mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la bdud rtsi gtor zhing sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon la sogs pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar bskyed la so so'i sngags dang 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bsangs shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du rje btsun ma sgrub thabs ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i steng du bla ma dang*/ khor yug tu dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam/ gong du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur zhing phul/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ rje btsun ma la sogs pa'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ chos skyong dang phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la mchod cing byin/ mthar rang gi lce la myang zhing oṃ gsum ma brjod de pad skor gyi phyag rgya dang*/ mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul byas pas mnyes par bya'o// de nas yid kyis sprul pa dang bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pas mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad dam/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod/ gtor ma dang po rje btsun ma la oṃ gsum mar oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ /zhes btags pas dbul/ gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong la/ de nas lnga'am ma grub na gcig mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gong gi cho gas dbul/ tha ma gzhi bdag dang de'i lhag ma rigs drug la sbyin no// de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab ste/ rdo rje dril bu spos 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan ye shes rdo rje mchog /rig 'dzin rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal// snying rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du// slob ma gzhug par 'tshal lags na// ji ltar rgyal ba kun gyis khyod// ye shes rgya mtshor byin brlabs pa// de bzhin du ni ye shes ros// sems can 'di la byin brlab rigs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gtso mos gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas bum pa bsangs shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha'i gos kyis mgul pa g.yogs shing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan par bskyed pa'i nang du rje btsun ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod cing bstod de/

bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer ltar 'phros pa gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul nas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ mthar mchod cing bstod la dung chos kyi chu blugs pas rkyen byas te bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// de nas dad pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gis smin par byas pa'i slob ma khrus byas shing phyag 'tshal nas gral la rim pas 'khod pa la/ bla mas srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las bdag brgal zhing gzhan bsgral ba'i phyir/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mai tri mkha' la spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba zhu snyam pa gyis la maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul te bla ma la gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yis// 'gro ba byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir// ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// thams cad rig par rang gis byin// de bzhin bdag la'ang mgon po kye// da lta nyid du sbyin par rigs// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /de nas go skabs yangs shing byed par spro na/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi nas maṇ+ḍal re dang tshig res gsol ba gdab/ de tsam ma grub na yid kyis de ltar bsam zhing*/ dngos su maṇ+ḍal lan bzhi dbul/ rje btsun ma la gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ lha mo lus ngag yid kyis su// ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal// ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis// thams cad ye shes byin brlabs pa// de bzhin bdag rgyud dag la yang*// ye shes rgyun gyis mdzad du gsol// zhes lan bzhi brjod du gzhug go /de nas gdong bcings te me tog gi phreng ba gtad de/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing sum+bha nis bsang*/ bdud rtsi lce la gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/

snying ga'i nang du zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gnyis kas bsam/ bla mas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya stāṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas sems bskyed nas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor du khrid par mos pa gyis zhes brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams lha mo'i skur bsam pa ni/ gong bur bsdu ba nas go cha bcing ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar gnyis kas bsgom zhing gnas gsum byin brlab/ lha mo'i sku las mkha' 'gro du ma spro zhing sdud pa'i lus can du bsam zhing yid gzung*/ yang gong bur bsdu ba'am rjes su gzhig pa gang rung gi dmigs pa bya/ yang skad cig gis lha mo'i skur bsam/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo zur drug pa yig 'bru dang bcas 'khor ba dang*/ gsang ba'i gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa gsang gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ mdzod spur 'khor bas lus drod dang bde bas gang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pas lus la thim nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes zhugs par dpon slob gnyis kas bsgom zhing gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi dud pas bdug ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra drag po bya zhing oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod/ de ltar dmigs pa de dag spos shing phab pas lus ngag yid gsum la ye shes babs pa'i rtags ci rigs pa 'byung ngo*// de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing oṃ tīṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod do// de nas me tog gi phreng ba de rje btsun ma'i dbu gtsug tu phul bar sgoms zhes brjod la/

dngos su las kyi rdo rjes dbul zhing*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod du gzhug go /phreng ba de nyid sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas slob ma'i mgo la bzhag cing*/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇe i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ zhes brjod do// de nas oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hiḥzhes brjod cing gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan no// slob mas bltas te gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing lha mo'i sku dngos su mthong snyam du bsam mo// de nas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug go /de nas rje btsun ma'i mdun du rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la slob ma lha mor bsgom du gzhug de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ g.yas na rgyal mtshan g.yon na ba dan khor yug tu mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pa brjod cing gtso mos bum chus dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dngos su/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing*// zhes sogs kyi mthar/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ tsakra wī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas slob ma'i lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sogs sangs rgyas lngas dbu brgyan par bsam mo// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas pa'am gnas par mos la lha mo'i skur bsgom/

bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi phreng ba chad cing bla ma'i zhal nas slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la g.yon skor du 'khod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum rjes su bzlas pas sngags kyi lung byin la/ bla ma'i lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgo bor btud cing sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas slob ma lha mo'i phyag zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur ltar byed du bcug la/ de'i g.yon du bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yas su rdo rje gtad cing gong gi bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa sgom du bcug la thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug go /de dag ni sngags dang spyod pa rjes su gnang ba'o// de ltar khyed kyis bum pa'i dbang thob bo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas sha chen nam sha phal pa mar du btsos pa dang maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og gi bdud rtsi lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du sbyin nas gsang ba'i dbang thob bo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas lha mo'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum nas blangs pa'i rdul tshon gyis slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le byas pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal zhing lus sems la bde ba rgyas par bsams la/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob bo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas chos thams cad skye med spros bral du ngo sprad la 'dzin med kyi ngang la re zhig gzhag go /des dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod sgrub pa dang*/ ras bris bri thabs dang bcas pa tshar gcig bshad la sgrub par gdams/ slob ma dam tshig dang sdom pa mdor bsdus te khas blang ba dang*/ lus longs spyod thams cad gtang rag tu phul la/ dngos su ci 'byor pa'i yon phul zhing bka' drin che ba lags so zhes tshig gi gtang rag dbul lo// de nas gtor ma gtong na skabs 'dir btang la dga' ston la longs spyad/

lag mchod sngar ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa sin+dhu ra'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ dge ba bsngo/ sin+dhu ra bsdus nas snod bzang por blugs la phyis kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bri ba la bsres na shin tu byin rlabs che gsungs/ gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar gtang*/ bdag nyid bsrungs la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// lo ke shwa ra ri khrod dbang phyug mai tri pa// ka ma la dang des rje dza ya se na dang*// dar ma yon tan grags pa rgyal mtshan chos kyi rje// rin chen tshogs dang yon tan mtha' yas 'od zer can// nye brgyud yin zhing ring brgyud gzhan du shes par bya// rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma las byung bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i// bud med ye shes sgyu ma'i tshul 'di gnyis med rdo rje

mai tri pa 'i gsung rab dang*// man ngag ji bzhin bdag gis bkod la bdag blo'i nyes gang bzod par gsol// dge ba gang des ma lus 'gro kun mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug nyid gyur cig /rnam 'byed stobs chung le lo'i dbang gyur kun dga'i ming can gang yin la// blo gros rab gsal sde snod 'dzin par grags pa gzhon nu la sogs pa'i// don gnyer dga' yis bskul ba'i zhal ngor mkha' spyod sgrub pa rjes gnang bcas// lcags pho byi lo'i brgyad pa'i brgyad la spru lung nags phug dgon par sbyar// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī/ yon tan mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// mkhyen brtse bsil ba'i 'od tshogs rab mnga' ba// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso la bstod par bgyi// gdod nas rnam dag chos dbyings nam mkha' la// glo bur dri ma'i rdul gyis ma gos shing*// mkha' ltar mtha' yas brtan g.yo kun gyi dngos// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zung 'jug bde la rol pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis// srid gsum ma lus bde bas tshim mdzad nas// zag med bde chen dbyings su thim mdzad ma// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'dud// gang zhig gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas// de dang de la de yi mos pa bzhin// rnam 'phrul sna tshogs rnam par sprul mdzad ma// rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyings las ma g.yos sprul pa'i sku brnyes kyang*// 'gro la brtse phyir dpal gyi ri sogs rtser// rin chen khang pa'i ldum rwa yid 'ong bar// rol zhing rtse bar ston la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed gsung ming tshig yi ges dben gyur kyang*// phyag 'tshal yi ge gsum pa'i rig sngags kyi// mtha' yas gsung gi gsang bas 'gro kun la// spyod dang grol ba stsol la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog mtshan ma'i spros pa nyer zhi yang*// ji bzhin ji snyed mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor las// thugs rje'i 'od kyis sa gsum gsal mdzad ma// zab cing rgya che'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum rnam dag sku yi gzhal yas khang*// sum cu rtsa gnyis sngags kyis rab brgyan zhing*// e wam̐ g.yung drung thugs kyi rin chen na// mi rtog bde chen 'byung gnas mchog la 'dud// sems can don la brtson pa'i rnam 'phrul dang*// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag med spro bsdu yis// mtha' yas 'gro ba bde la 'god mdzad ma// phrin las phrin las spyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod dang gnyis med bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// khyod kyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba thob// dad dang brtson pas bsgrub cing gsol 'debs na// 'di la khyed kyi thugs rje cis mi 'jug

/'on kyang skal ngan bdag blo'i nyes pa yis// tshe 'dir rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal med na// 'chi kha'am bar dor khyod kyis rjes bzung nas// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khyod thugs ye shes rgya mtshor bdag zhugs shing*// dngos grub rin chen bang mdzod sgo phye nas// chos kyis phongs pa'i skye rgu tshim byed cing*// phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog tu 'gyur bar mdzod// ma ltar brtse bas khyod kyis 'gro kun la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis byin brlabs shing*// gsang chen bla med theg pa rab zhon nas// thar pa chen po'i grong du phyin par mdzod// grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma la// bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig 'di dag /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' smon lam gyis/ mi rje'i bzhugs gnas yul chos khab tu sbyar/ ༈ /mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// ༈ /'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i mdangs 'od can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mkha' spyod gzigs// mkha' 'gro dpag med 'phro 'du'i rje btsun ma// rig pa 'dzin mas bdag dang 'gro 'di skyongs// de la 'dir mai tri mkha' spyod kyi bsgom bzlas byed par 'dod pas skyabs sems dang yig brgya'i bzlas pa tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid bam̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar sku mdog dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pa steng du phyogs shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur thur du 'phyang ba/

phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du btegs nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/ sku la man+dā ra ba dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas rnams su lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mtshogs mar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ de nas snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod cing rang la bstim/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sogs kyis mchod/ dbang bskur ba gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa bya ba/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ yig oṃ gsum mas g.yon du bskor ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang gang*/ bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis 'phel zhing rgyas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par 'dus/ snying ga'i bam̐ dang sngags phreng la thim par bsams la oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzla/ 'di'i rdzogs rim bsgom par spro na spru lung pa'i yi ge bzhin bya ste/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab tshar ba'i rjes la bsgom pa yin no// bsdu ba'i tshul ni snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/

rang snying ga'i bam̐ la/ de khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang je phra la song nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang la cung zhig bzhag de'i ngang las slar rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur par bsams la/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo sogs go cha gsal/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs kyis bsngo ba bya/ slob ma byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul ni/ yar ngo mar ngo gang yang rung ba'i tshes bcu la/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi la rdul tshon dmar po'i chos 'byung gru gsum/ de'i dbus su re khā dkar po la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du mañdza'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhag de'i khar me long la sin+dhu ra'i chos 'byung gi dbus su lha mo'i sku bskyed chog bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa/ g.yas g.yon du ri'i gzugs re dang bcas pa bris la bzhag sku 'bri ma thub na tshon phung dmar po bya/ steng du dar dmar gyi gur phub pa'am ma phub kyang rung*/ khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma lnga'am gnyis bshams/ bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba kha rgyan dang dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa dkyus bzhin/ bdag gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril/ gzhan yang slob ma la dgos pa'i gdong g.yogs dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ sha chen dngos sam/ de med na sha dmar mar khu la btsos pa rnams bsham mo// de nas slob dpon rang nyid gdan la 'khod nas skyabs sems yi ge brgya pa bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngar bshad pa bzhin bsgom/ de nas mchod pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog nas bzung rol mo'i bar ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ 'bru gsum brjod/ de nas mdun gyi thod pa la dmigs te oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ

lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dmigs nas sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du rje btsun ma sgrub thabs ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ steng gi cha la bla ma dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa 'bul bar mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ nas shab+da'i bar mtshan sngags sbyar la mthar rol mo 'bul lo// nang mchod nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha rnams kyi zhal du= dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang phyogs skyong la sogs pa dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la sbyin no// mthar rang gi lce la myang zhing oṃ gsum ma brjod pa dang pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud rgya bya/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ spro na yum gyi rkang brgyad kyang bya/ gtor ma la bdud rtsi byin rlabs rgyas pa'am/ yang na oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ gsum la a ra li ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang po rje btsun ma la phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod/ bstod pa bya/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa chos skyong nas bzung gzhi bdag gi bar bsngo ba rgyas pa/ bsdu na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis chog de nas rdor dril dang spos 'dzin zhing*/ bcom ldan ye shes rdo rje mchog /rig 'dzin rgyal mo phyag 'tshal lo// snying rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du// slob ma 'jug pa 'tshal lags na// ji ltar rgyal ba kun gyis khyod// ye shes rgya mtshor byin rlabs la// de bzhin du ni ye shes ros// sems can 'di la byin rlabs rigs// lan gsum gyis ni gsol ba btab/

gtso mos gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba sogs dkyus bzhin bskyed pa'i nang du rje btsun ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod cing bstod/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thags la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs brgyud bskul nas sku las bdud rtsi babs pas bum nang gang bar bsam zhing oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa bzlas/ mthar yang mchod cing bstod la dung chos kyi chu phul bas lha zhu ste bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ de nas 'di slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug len par ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do// spro na/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo dang bla ma tha mi dad pa la maṇ+ḍal dang gsol btab nas bzung*/ ji ltar sogs kyi bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ slob ma mdun du 'khod pa la sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral ba'i phyir/ byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo zhu snyam pa'i thugs bskyed pa zhu/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bla med gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam du bka' babs pa'i nang nas zab chos khyad par can du gyur pa thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhar las 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum/ mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum rnams su grags pa las/ dmar mo skor gsum ni in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ mai tri mkha' spyod dang gsum po 'di yin la/ gsum po de'i nang nas da lam mai tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi bka' yin/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed mdun bskyed la sogs pa bsgrubs zin nas/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la slob dpon mkha' spyod mar gsal ba la byin rlabs bka' zhu ba'i yon du dmigs nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug

gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsung bar zhu/ lha mo lus ngag yid kyis su// ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal// ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis// thams cad ye shes byin brlabs so// de bzhin bdag rgyud dag pa la// ye shes rgyun bzhin mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ spro na gur gyi rgyun bshags bya/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis mig ras bcings/ sngags de nyid kyis me tog phreng ba gtad/ sum+bha ni brjod cing mtheb srin gyis slob ma'i lus la bdud rtsi gtor/ 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi byin/ zla ba rdo rje ngo sprod pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i nang du zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gcig lam gyis bsgoms la 'di gsung bar zhu/ oṃ sarba yo ga sogs brjod du gzhug de brtan par bya ba'i phyir slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste su ra te sogs slob dpon rang gis brjod/ yang slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la ma yin no// slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i mos pa gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod do// ye shes dbab pa'i don du thugs 'dun pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma rig pa 'dzin ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar dkyus bzhin brjod la/ sku can du lam ste bsgom pa zhu/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ sogs go cha bkod/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ de ltar gsal ba'i lte bar 'khor lo zur drug pa yig 'bru dang bcas pa 'khor ba dang*/

gsang gnas dang mdzod spur yang dga' 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor bas lus drod dang bde bas gang*/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim zhing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig gu gul la sogs pa'i dud pas bdug ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra drag po bya zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ de sngar gyi me tog gi phreng ba de mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma'i dbu'i gtsug tu phul ba'i mos pa gyis la oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod du gzhug phreng ba de slob dpon gyis blangs te oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas slob ma'i mgo la bzhag cing*/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ oṃ badz+ra ne pra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hri zhes brjod/ de ltar mig dar bsal bas khyed rang rnams mdun bskyed kyi chos 'byung gi nang nas pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma rig pa 'dzin ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin brjod la/ de ltar mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de yan 'jug pa'i chos song*/ dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol btab lan gsum/ bum dbang gi slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ khyed rang rnams mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma'i mdun du rin po che'i khri pad nyi'i gdan la rje btsun ma rig pa 'dzin mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas na rgyal mtshan/ g.yon ba dan/ khor yug mchod pa'i phreng ba dang bcas te bzhugs pa la mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar byon nas/

khyed rang rnams la bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ mchod pa 'bul zhing bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pa brjod pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon gyis tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings la sogs sam/ yang na phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra sogs kyi tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la mdun gyi rje btsun mas bum chus dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas khyed rang gi lus thams cad byang sems chu rgyun gyis gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sogs kyi sangs rgyas rigs lngas

dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba chad/ zhal nas 'thon khyod rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la g.yon skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa gnang*/ 'di'i rjes zlos gsung ba zhu/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum/ de brtan byed du slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams lha mo'i phyag zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur ltar dngos su byed du bcug pa'am de ma byung na'ang 'gal ba med la/ g.yon du thod chang g.yas su rdo rje gtad la/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i phyag g.yon du bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ g.yas su rdo rje gtad pa 'di spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin brjod/ thur mas bdud rtsi de nas blangs la byin/ de ltar khyed kyis bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas gsang dbang gi slad du/ sha chen nam med na sha phal pa mar du btsos pa lag g.yas su gtad/ sin+dhu ra'i 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob pa yin/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du sin+dhu ra la bris pa'i lha mo'i sku'i dpral bar mgrin par snying ga gsum nas rdul tshon blangs la oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le bya/ rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal zhing lus la bde bas khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin/ dbang bzhi pa'i slad du chos skye 'gag med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de'i ngang du 'dzin med cung zad re 'jog par zhu/ des dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang*/

mdun bskyed la mchod bstod yig brgyas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs pa rnams dkyus bzhin/ dam tshig pa zhu bas sin+dhu ra'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ dge ba bsngo/ de ltar mai tri mkha' spyod byin rlabs kyi// cho ga mi nub bklag chog tshul du bkod// chos 'di'i bka' lung chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// rgyun mi chad pa'i dge legs lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis spro lung pa kun smon gyi yi ge dang*/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi zin tho la gzhi byas/ chu mo bya'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes la spu dkar bla brang rdzong du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i mchog dam par gyur cig brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ dpa' bo spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ ri khrod dbang phyug grub chen mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra/ dza ya se na/ sum pa lo tsā/ dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje khu dbon man in+d+ra mkha' spyod dang 'dra'o// ༈ /grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags pas grub par bkod pa mkha' spyod grub pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'khor lo'i mgon dang dbyer med pa'i// rig pa 'dzin ma'i rje btsun mar// btud nas de yi byin rlabs tshul// mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i rgyun du sbyin// 'di la bzhi/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga 'phros don gzhan cung zad bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ dbang thob cing byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan cing gzhi'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi bsham bkod dang*/

mchod pa'i yo byad sogs spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha las 'byung ba ltar 'du bya/ de'ang ngag chos pa'i yig char sku 'bri ma thub na tshon phung tsam gyis chog pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bum pa bca' ba sogs kyang spyi ltar byas pas chog par gsungs pa spros pa bsdus pa'i tshe dgongs par mngon na'ang*/ rgya gzhung las snga ma ltar 'byung bas legs so// gzhan yang cho ga gzhan dang mi 'brel na sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du ḍā ma ru dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa byed na nye logs ci bde bar tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa'ang 'du bya/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs rnams nā ro mkha' spyod sogs dang 'dra/ tshogs pa mang po yod na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad ma bde kye ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ slob ma rjes su gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyang nā ro mkha' spyod sogs kyi cho ga las 'byung ba ltar bya/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i skur gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ spru lung pa'i yig cha'i dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar 'bru gsum brjod cing myang ba nas bzung dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i bar dang*/ spro na slar yang rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ rdzogs rim dang spyod pa'i dmigs pa cung zad bsgom zhing*/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas la/

bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sogs kyi mal du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes bsgyur/ mdun bskyed kyi steng gi nam mkhar bla ma dang*/ khor yug tu dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ spro na nā ro mkha' spyod sogs kyi cho ga rgyas pa las 'byung ba ltar mchod phreng spros te byas kyang rung mod/ dkyus ltar na phyi mchod dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'i rjes/ yid byung gi mchod pa na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs nas/ tsā ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams nā ro mkha' spyod ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad byas rjes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis brlabs te dang po rje btsun ma la dkyus ltar dbul/ gnyis pa nag po chen po sogs chos skyong 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la gtor chog ltar dbul ba'am/ ma grub na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sogs chos skyong ye shes pa'i tshogs thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sogs gyis bstod/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi gtor ma lnga mkha' 'gro sde lnga la dbul te/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sogs las sngags kyis thugs rgyud bskul/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki sogs gtor ma dbul/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki sogs kyis bstab pa bya/ gtor ma gcig las med na gtor ma so sor 'bul ba'i sngags rnams sbrel/ mthar oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs de nyid lnga pa'am/ ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ tha ma gzhi bdag la 'bul ba ni/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol// bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥs gshegs su gsol la lhag ma a kā ro lan gsum gyis rigs drug spyi la bsngo/ slob ma gzhug pa'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa dkyus ltar bya/ gsum pa ni/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha'i gos kyis mgul pa g.yogs shing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gi nang du nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar/ phyi nang gis mchod/

dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sogs bzlas pa dang 'od zhu bar dkyus ltar bya'o// bzhi pa la gnyis/ thog mar bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma rjes su gzung ba dngos so// dang po ni/ spru lung pa'i yig char mi gsal yang*/ ngag dbang chos grags pas spro na bya gsungs pa ltar yig cha gzhan las kyang 'byung bas slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i byin rlabs kyi chos rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i slob ma nyer lnga man zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus bya/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul te rang rang gi gral du 'khod pa la slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang legs par gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la rnal 'byor bla med dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bka' babs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba'i snyan brgyud gser chos bcu gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan/ mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal/ grub chen mai tri gup+tas rgyud ral pa gyen brdzes la brten nas legs par bkral ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ paṇa grub dza ya se nas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i byin rlabs zab mo bsgrub pa la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas/

dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba rnam pa gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas maṇ+ḍal lan gsum 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yis// 'gro ba byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir// ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// thams cad rig par rang gis byin// de bzhin bdag la'ang mgon po kye// da lta nyid du sbyin par rigs// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi pha mas thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum brjod/ ces rgyud dag par byas nas/ sngon ched rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang slar yang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcing bar mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcing*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas u dum+ba ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re byin par mos pa mdzod/

ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ bar chad bsal ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te khyed rang rnams la byin rlabs zab mo bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ sum+bha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/ slar yang slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi khyed rang rnams kyi ljags thog dang*/ sku lus la gtor te nang rtsa khams kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing zag med kyi bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa bco lnga'i nya gang ba lta bu skya 'khyil ba re gsal btab la/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gyen du langs byung bar mos te bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed nas/ gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod thams cad snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas/

nang 'jug gi slad du rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes gsungs shing dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid nas shar phyogs su 'khod par mos pas/ slar yang khyad par can gyi don la nan tan du gsol ba gdab pa'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma tha mi dad pa la maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan bzhi'i bar du gnang bar zhu zhes mtshams sbyar la/ go skabs yangs shing byed par spro na dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs so so dang*/ de tsam ma grub na yid kyis de ltar byed par bsam zhing dngos su maṇ+ḍal re dang*/ lha mo lus ngag yid kyis su// ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal// ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis// thams cad ye shes byin brlabs pa// de bzhin bdag rgyud dag la yang*// ye shes rgyun gyis mdzad du gsol// zhes 'di spru lung pa'i yig char gong du 'byung yang skabs 'dir byas na spyi dang mthun pas legs/ spel la lan bzhi bya'o// de ltar gsol ba btab nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po mar me ltar 'bar ba zhig gsal btab ste/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas bam̐ yig la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad pas de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang rang gi lus dang khams gsum thams cad gang bas khams gsum thams cad 'od du zhu/ me long la has btab pa ltar rim gyis bsdus te rang rang gi lus la thim/ lus kyi rkang pa gnyis brla la/ de lto ba la/ de sked pa la/ de snying ga la/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la/ de snying ga la/ de mgrin pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de sems la/ de nam mkha' la/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gyur par mos pa mdzod/

de'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin mar gyur pa ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mdangs can zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pas steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du bteg nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/ man+dā ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng ba g.yon na 'dzin cing rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mtshogs mar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi ka dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ mig sogs bu ga thams cad la hūm̐ yig re res mtshan pa/ mkha' 'gro du ma spro zhing sdud pa'i skur gyur par mos pa dang bcas te sems 'dzin par zhu/ yang khyed rang rnams lha mor gsal ba bam̐ yig chen po gcig tu gyur/ de je che je che la mthar nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ slar yang khyed rang rnams lha mo'i skur lam ste gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung zur drug pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa dang bcas gsal btab nas g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems bzung nas drod kyi ye shes skyes/

'khor lo de nyid gsang gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems bzung bas bde ba'i ye shes skyes/ mdzod spur dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems bzung bas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes shing lus thams cad drod dang bde bas gang*/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te lus la sib sib thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgyud la zhugs par mos pa mdzod ces brda sbyar la/ gu gul gyis bdug ḍā ma rus thog drangs pa'i rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod pas dbab/ de ltar ye shes phab pas lus bde zhing gar byed pa dang*/ ngag saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra ba dang*/ yid la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ci rigs pa 'byung ba yin la/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog 'dor ba ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ rim pa ltar byon nas g.yon pa'i phyag gis me tog de rje btsun ma'i dbu la phul bar mos te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing me tog 'dor bar zhu/ de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa hā ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥtram̐/ zhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling tog dang mig ras lhan cig tu bsal te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/

chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i steng du bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pas steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du bteg nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/ man+dā ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng ba g.yon na 'dzin cing brgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ mdor na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas/ zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon tan maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis gegs skrod pa dang*/

mchod pa dang bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pa brjod cing gtso mo'i phyag na bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ las kyi rdo rjes bum pa slob ma'i phyogs su bteg slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi glad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod pa'i mthar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ tsakra wī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sogs sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo me tog ma la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ nai wi d+ya'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ de nas khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su 'khod pa'am/ 'khod par mos te sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba bye ru bstar la brgyus pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs te/ zhal nas thon pa'i sngags phreng dang dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma'i sku can du gyur pa'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du dmar 'khyil gyis 'khod par mos pa byas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces brjod la oṃ gsum ma'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug de brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje dang bcas pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la thal mo spyi bor bzhag cing sngags brjod/ spyod pa'i rjes gnang gi slad du/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma'i sku'i rnam 'gyur du byas pa'i phyag g.yon du bdud rtsi dang*/ g.yas su rdo rje bzung nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir spyod yul gyi gnas su 'jug par 'dod pas mkha' 'gro spro bsdu dang bcas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing*/ ma na bhaṃ ga dang*/ dpal gyi ri'i rtse mor rim gyis phyin te/ man+dā ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du rnams skyes pa'i ldum gyi rwa ba rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i khang par zhugs par bsams la/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i mthil ri la brdabs pas brtan g.yo thams cad bskyod cing sems can thams cad kyi rgyud bde bas gang zhing 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rnams rlung 'jug pa dang bstun nas g.yon gyi thod par bsdus shing sna bug g.yon nas btung bas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar mos pa mdzod/

ces sgom du gzhug cing bdud rtsi sbyin/ de dag ni sngags dang spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// gsang dbang gi slad du/ thabs bde ba chen po mtshon par byed pa sha chen nam sha phal pa mar la btsos pa phyag g.yas dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid mtshon par byed pa sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi phyag g.yon du byin te de'ang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod bzhin du byin/ des khyed rnams kyis gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi lha mo'i gnas gsum nas blangs pa'i rdul tshon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thig le bkod pa la brten nas/ rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing lus sems la bde bas khyab cing rgyas par mos pa mdzod/ rtsa sngags brjod bzhin du thig le bya/ des khyed rnams kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ chos thams cad skye 'gag med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar shes par byas te de'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des khyed rnams kyis dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyis thob pa yin no// bar 'dir sgrub thabs kyi lung bklag cing*/ rjes dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba rnams spyi ltar bya/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mai tri mkha' spyod du grags pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/
