tshogs kyi mchod pa yod na spyi ltar bya zhing dga' ston la longs spyad/ gsum pa ni/ mchod pa rnams zhal bsos la bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pas bstod/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas/ badz+ra muḥs sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa dang*/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa sin+dhu ra'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ sogs go cha dgod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur sogs bsngo smon dang bkra shis ji ltar rigs par brjod/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ byin rlabs kyi skabs yig rnying dang*/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs las gong du bkod pa dang cung zad mi mthun pa'i khyad par/ bum dbang gi skabs su byur bsal ba sngon du 'gro bas slob ma lha mor bskyed cing go cha sogs bkod par chu dbang bskur/ gsang dbang 'dra/ byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi slob ma lhar gsal ba dang*/ rtsa sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bdud rtsis 'thor 'thung bya ba sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bu bsdu ba/ rjes gzhig drod dang*/ mi rtog pa dang*/ bde ba'i ye shes dbab pa rnams kyi mthar brtan par byed pa rnams dbang gong ma gnyis kyi don thub dang*/ sbyong ba'i rjes gnang sbyin par mdzad de/ rgya gzhung gi dgongs par gsungs pa don la gnas mod/ 'dir bkod pa'ang spru lung pa'i yig cha las/ bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis gong 'og 'brel bsdebs te don gyi gnad tshang bar mdzad pa ltar la rgya gzhung sogs kyi dgongs pa med du mi rung pas cung zad brgyan te bkod pa yin pas 'gal bar mi bsam zhing*/ khyad par rang lugs la deng sang gi bar du bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes kyang 'di ltar mdzad pa yin no// ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha ni spru lung pa'i yi ge'i snying po'i bcud phyungs pa lta bur snang na'ang cung zad bsdus ches par snang ngo*// gong bu bsdu ba'i skabs ji skad du/

rang lus sum cu rtsa drug khams kyi tshogs// mig sna rna lce lus te dbang po lnga// ngag dang rkang lag bshang gci las dbang lnga// rang bzhin dag kyang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i// ma lus 'gro drug sems can tshogs// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal gyi// 'khor lo bskor ba 'di dag ni// nges par byang chub la gzhug bya// zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu'i tshul la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje sgyu ma lta bus snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdu ba la 'jug pa yin no// rjes su gzhig pa ni ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar rang lus bam̐ yig tu gsal ba stong par gzhug pa de yin la/ gang ltar yang stong nyid kyi ngang las rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa man chad 'dra'o// 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tshul la/ bsnyen pa ni spru lung pa'i yig cha'i dkyus su gsal/ sin+dhu ra sgrub pa dang*/ grub nas las la sbyar te spyod pa bya ba'i tshul ni dkyus su mdo tsam gsungs pa ltar/ rgyas pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi man ngag dang mthun pas de'i khrid yig rnams las gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// rig pa 'dzin pa'i byin rlabs tshul// shin tu gsal bar brjod pa'i dges// mkha' spyod grub pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// sa gsum 'jig rten rgyan gyur cig /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon sa skya pa chen po sogs kyi zhal snga nas tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa maṅga laṃ dhū yā tra// ༈ /

mai tri mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mkha' spyod dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// spyan ras gzigs dbang blo gros rin chen zhabs// ri khrod dbang phyug grub chen mai tri pa// badz+ra pā ṇi rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma rdo rje dza ya se na dang*// sum pa lo tsā rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs// sa paṇa 'phags pa zhang ston brag phug pa// blo gros brtan pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan tshul khrims ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po shes rab bzang po dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje shākya don grub zhabs// kun dga' legs grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' chos grags mchog legs rdo rje dang*// bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// kun dga' lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang*// kun dga' blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dang*// brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig rnam par dag /byin rlabs bdud rtsis ye shes skye ba dang*// rim gnyis spyod par bcas pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyis// mkha' spyod go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge/ tshar lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na rje btsun gong ma man rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
